question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a purple ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a orange ball, Dave has a white ball, Eve has a teal ball, Fred has a yellow ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Alice swap balls. Finally, Bob and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) purple ball
(B) brown ball
(C) orange ball
(D) white ball
(E) teal ball
(F) yellow ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: purple, brown, orange, white, teal, yellow, pink
1. Bob and Fred: purple, yellow, orange, white, teal, brown, pink
2. Gertrude and Alice: pink, yellow, orange, white, teal, brown, purple
3. Dave and Alice: white, yellow, orange, pink, teal, brown, purple
4. Gertrude and Alice: purple, yellow, orange, pink, teal, brown, white
5. Bob and Alice: yellow, purple, orange, pink, teal, brown, white
6. Claire and Alice: orange, purple, yellow, pink, teal, brown, white
7. Bob and Claire: orange, yellow, purple, pink, teal, brown, white
Claire has the purple ball, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
